target.primary_question: At the solar-glass responsibility boundary, does cutoff-visible capacity or commissioning have customer absorption, realized price or spread, operating cash and cash-capex support sufficient for base owner-cash treatment?
target.strongest_rival: Solar-demand recovery and cost or technology advantage could allow utilization and unit economics to absorb capacity before any capacity reduction.

guidance.proposition: In a capital-intensive manufacturing expansion under price pressure, installed capacity or scale does not establish durable economics until responsibility-matched price, cost or mix, cash-capex absorption, and financing or recoverability evidence support the same path.
apply_when: The target has a capital-intensive manufacturing expansion and a cutoff-visible risk that scale is being used as a proxy for unit economics.
The target can be examined through a responsibility-matched product or business-line economics carrier and a cash-capex carrier.
do_not_apply_when: The target lacks a comparable responsibility boundary for either economics or cash, in which case the affected claim stays conditional rather than being inferred from group results.
A capacity completion, aggregate shipment, group liquidity, or one-period cash number is being substituted for the full mechanism.
guidance.strongest_rival: A cyclical price and cost recovery can restore returns before capacity is reduced, so one weak period does not prove that the manufacturing base is permanently impaired.
observable_signals: Same-boundary revenue and margin rather than capacity or a combined volume series.
Operating cash and cash capital expenditure under the same responsibility boundary.
A directly disclosed financing or recoverability bridge when permanent-loss treatment depends on it.
guidance.investor_relevance: Keep incremental capacity outside normal owner-cash treatment until current-company product economics and cash absorption are independently supported; investigate permanent-loss transmission without calling an unresolved cash screen a complete conclusion.

guidance.proposition: A profitable core, a new option, and group cash must remain on their own responsibility boundaries; deployment examples or group cash cannot establish the option's recurring economics.
apply_when: A target has a mature core and a separately discussed incremental business line whose economics could be masked by group cash.
do_not_apply_when: The target's cash and incremental economics are already reported at the same responsibility boundary.
A group cash figure is being used as proof that the incremental line has earned a return.
guidance.strongest_rival: Early technology or new-line investment can create a valuable option before separate recurring economics are disclosed.
observable_signals: A target business-line revenue, profit or cash carrier rather than aggregate group cash.
A current-company discriminator showing whether the incremental line absorbs capital on its own economics.
guidance.investor_relevance: Preserve a plausible option in a named scenario, but exclude it from the current base cash treatment until current-company evidence closes the responsibility boundary.

not_an_answer: Retrieved experience may change questions, rival checks, evidence order, or a conditional treatment; it is not a target-company fact or conclusion.
